verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs list real-time evaluation of live traffic as a webhook use case: webhooks fire as production requests complete and can be filtered by properties to score responses for quality, safety, and relevance. The scoring logic itself appears to run in the user's own external system rather than as built-in evaluators. Missing for 10: native managed evaluators running on production traffic, built-in score storage and dashboards for online evals, sampling controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
